data.one_liner: A Flutter plugin to trigger haptic feedback and vibrations on iOS and Android.
data.what_it_does: It provides a unified API for generating device vibrations and platform-specific haptic feedback types like impacts, selections, success, and error signals. It supports standard vibrations, custom pause patterns on Android, and haptic generators on iOS.
use_when: You need to provide tactile feedback for user interactions like button taps or form submissions.
You want cross-platform haptic feedback and custom vibration patterns.
avoid_when: Your target platforms include Web, macOS, Linux, or Windows since they are not supported.
You need complex audio-tactile sequencing beyond basic vibrations and predefined haptics.
strengths: Unifies haptic feedback APIs across Android and iOS.
Supports custom vibration patterns with variable pauses on Android.
Built with Pigeon for type-safe platform communication.
weaknesses: Limited platform support (only Android and iOS).
Custom vibration patterns have limited fine-grained support on iOS.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding the VIBRATE permission to AndroidManifest.xml for full vibration functionality.
